verdict.rationale: An IP office could plausibly publish versioned APIs for searching and filing, so this axis applies. The evidence pack covers only gov.uk guidance pages, online and paper filing routes, web search tools, and a probe showing the search host blocks agents at robots.txt. It has nothing on versioned APIs or a deprecation policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
